title: Zoning text change for affordable housing at 862 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This application establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 862-868 Kent Avenue and 123-125 Taaffe Place in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would facilitate two new residential buildings with 74 total units, 19 of them permanently income-restricted. The Council approved the measure on September 24, 2026.
